target_demo: Korean adults ~30s-40s, predominantly men, outdoor/leisure and active-lifestyle buyers drawn to a rugged-yet-premium dual-cab pickup; also brand-revival watchers of the KGM (ex-SsangYong) Musso nameplate
narrative_arc: A dark cinematic fade-in resolves into the front of a graphite pickup whose segmented LED grille bar and vertical headlight signatures ignite out of black. A slow forward push-in reveals the full truck parked in a dramatic white rocky CG canyon, its 'MUSSO' grille plate legible — a hushed, reverent hero reveal. The camera then rushes into the lit grille and bursts into a sweeping warm-toned cliff-and-mountain flythrough under stormy golden clouds, where a small bottom-left caption discloses that the film was partly made with generative AI. Energy spikes into a golden-hour desert off-road montage: a white Musso drifts and kicks up huge plumes of dust across an arid plain framed by mountains, intercut with moody dark-studio beauty inserts (side profile, wheel and sill macros) and a tactile reveal of the tailgate's embossed 'KGM' badge in the white canyon — a lower-right caption asserts 'powerful diesel & gasoline' powertrains. The film resolves to a calm studio lineup of two Musso trucks in different body colors against a stylized sky-and-mountain backdrop with a 'The Original MUSSO' title, then closes on a black end card bearing the 'KGM' logotype and the brand tagline 'Enjoy with Confidence'.

production_signature.signature_note: Two production techniques are fused: photoreal 3D-CG vehicle renders (the truck hero shots, studio beauty macros, tailgate and lineup) and generative-AI environment plates (the warm stormy canyon/mountain flythrough and the dusty desert off-road backgrounds). The ad EXPLICITLY discloses generative-AI use via a small bottom-left Korean caption '*이 영상은 생성형 AI를 활용하여 일부 제작되었습니다' during the flythrough. Camera language is high-end automotive cinematic: a slow reverent forward push-in for the dark hero reveal, a rush/whip into the lit grille that bursts into an aerial canyon flythrough, fast low tracking chases for the desert drift, slow orbits for the dark-studio beauty inserts, and a slow dolly across the two-truck color lineup. Wiggle metric mean_abs_shift_x 0.68 is ordinary cinematic camera movement (push-in/orbit/aerial/tracking), NOT lenticular or stereoscopic wiggle — confirmed on native-res frames; signature_effect is none. Audio is music-dominant; the faster-whisper tiny transcript is garbled/low-confidence (coverage 0.665) so on-screen text is authoritative.
production_signature.color_grade: bimodal cinematic grade — cool desaturated graphite-and-white for the rocky canyon hero and tailgate, versus warm amber/golden-hour for the stormy CG flythrough and the dusty desert montage; moody warm low-key for the dark-studio beauty inserts; clean cool sky-blue for the lineup; pure black for the endcard
production_signature.texture_fx: photoreal_pbr_vehicle_surfaces; volumetric_dust_and_haze; god_rays_and_atmosphere; lens_halation_and_flare; subtle_film_grain; generative_ai_environment_plates; clean_logotype_endcard

global_layout.subject_typo_relation: captions kept to the extreme lower corners so the vehicle and environment dominate — generative-AI disclaimer bottom-left, feature/spec caption bottom-right; the 'The Original MUSSO' title floats centered-top over the lineup; the end-card logotype is centered on black
global_layout.negative_space_use: generous sky, canyon walls and dust haze act as negative space framing the vehicle; the black hero open and black end card use pure darkness as negative space around the lit grille / logotype
global_layout.layout_note: A repeatable cinematic automotive template: hero vehicle composed centrally within a vast CG landscape, tiny corner captions for legal/spec text, a centered model-name title for the lineup, and a minimal centered brand logotype close — all in widescreen with a deliberate cool-vs-warm grade swing

recreation_prompts.t2i_start_frame: Widescreen 16:9 landscape cinematic still, extreme close-up of the front end of a large modern double-cab pickup truck emerging from near-total darkness. The frame begins almost pure black; the only fully lit elements are the vehicle's distinctive lighting signature: a horizontal LED light bar running across the upper grille, broken into a row of seven or eight rectangular segmented blocks that glow a clean cool white, and on each outer corner a tall vertical C-shaped LED headlight signature that traces down the fascia, plus two small lower fog/daytime-running lamps that punch bright white near the bumper. The truck is shot head-on from a slightly low, heroic angle so its broad muscular hood and upright squared-off front fascia loom as a dark silhouette around the glowing graphics; the bodywork is a dark graphite/near-black painted metal that only barely catches light along its top edges. Behind and around the vehicle, as the exposure begins to lift, a dim white rocky canyon faintly resolves — chalky pale boulders and quarried stone walls in deep shadow, reading as cool grey ghosts rather than fully lit forms. There is no on-screen text in this frame. Lighting is almost entirely self-emissive: the cool white LED lamps at roughly 6000K act as the only key, throwing a soft glow onto the immediate grille surfaces while everything else falls into crushed black; ambient skylight is minimal, so the contrast is extreme low-key chiaroscuro with deep crushed blacks and a single bright emissive accent. Lens rendering: a longer focal length around 85 to 135mm full-frame equivalent compressing the grille, a shallow plane of focus on the lit grille blocks, a faint cinematic halation blooming off the brightest LEDs, and a whisper of film grain in the shadows. Composition centers the glowing grille graphic in the frame as a luminous emblem floating in darkness, the vehicle's mass implied symmetrically around it. Color palette and strategy: a near-monochrome dark scheme — pure black negative-space field (#0A0A0B), dark graphite bodywork silhouette (#1A1B1D), glowing cool-white LED signature (#E8E6E2), dim white rock highlight (#C9CCCF) and cool grey shadow rock (#8A8D90); saturation is minimal and the emissive white is the lone accent occupying only a small fraction of the frame. Texture and surfaces: a finely textured glowing LED light-guide, matte dark automotive paint catching faint edge light, a glossy black grille surround, and chalky matte white rock dissolving into shadow behind. Atmosphere: mysterious, reverent, anticipatory — the hushed instant before a hero product is fully revealed, the lit face of the machine staring out of the dark. Post and signature look: high-end automotive cinematic CG render with photoreal physically-based materials, a cool desaturated grade, gentle lens halation on the lights, subtle grain, and pristine black levels; this is the opening beat of a premium pickup-truck commercial. Style anchor: high-end automotive CG commercial, Korean, blending photoreal 3D product rendering with a moody cinematic reveal of a hero machine. Render any badge or wordmark generically as an unbranded automaker grille graphic; no real logos, no people, no celebrity likeness, and no added caption text.

recreation_prompts.t2i_start_frame: Widescreen 16:9 landscape cinematic still of a sweeping aerial flythrough between towering rugged rock cliffs in a vast mountain wilderness lit by a dramatic warm golden storm. In the foreground, jagged striated cliff faces of warm amber-brown rock crowd the left and right edges of the frame as if the camera is threading between them at speed; their ridges are sharp and tactile. Beyond them a hazy valley opens up, its floor lost in drifting mist, leading the eye toward distant snow-tipped mountain peaks that catch a shaft of warm backlight. Above, enormous towering storm clouds fill the sky, their edges rimmed with golden light where the low sun breaks through in soft god-rays, the whole atmosphere thick with warm haze. Superimposed small in the lower-left corner is a single line of fine light-grey Korean caption text reading exactly '*이 영상은 생성형 AI를 활용하여 일부 제작되었습니다'. There is no vehicle in this frame; the landscape itself is the subject, conveying immense scale and adventurous grandeur. Lighting is a high warm backlight at roughly 4000K filtering through the cloud deck, soft and diffused, with medium fill bouncing off the haze, bright rims on the cloud and ridge edges, soft atmospheric shadows and a medium-high contrast that keeps the cliff foregrounds richer and the misty valley luminous. Lens rendering: a wide cinematic lens around 24 to 35mm full-frame equivalent for an immersive flythrough feel, deep focus on the cliff faces softening into atmospheric blur toward the peaks, a faint anamorphic-style flare where light catches the lens, and a whisper of grain. Composition uses the two cliff masses as strong diagonal framing wedges that funnel toward the bright misty valley and backlit peaks at the center, a classic adventure-vista funnel. Color palette and strategy: a rich warm analogous grade from amber to brown — warm rock midtone (#9A6A45), sunlit cliff and cloud edge (#C98F5E), shadowed rock (#7A5238), hazy warm sky and mist (#D9C2A0) and deep rock shadow (#4A3526); saturation is warm and golden, a deliberate dramatic tonal swing away from the cool white canyon that preceded it. Texture and surfaces: rugged striated warm rock with crisp fault lines, billowing soft cloud masses, and hazy atmospheric mountains dissolving into mist. Atmosphere: epic, stormy and adventurous — a soaring rush through monumental terrain. Post and signature look: this environment plate is rendered with a photoreal-yet-painterly generative quality, a warm cinematic grade, volumetric mist and god-rays, lens flare and subtle film grain, consistent with a film that openly uses generative AI for its landscape plates. Style anchor: high-end automotive CG commercial, Korean, with generative-AI environment plates. Preserve the on-screen Korean caption '*이 영상은 생성형 AI를 활용하여 일부 제작되었습니다' exactly; no real logos, no people, no celebrity likeness. Additional craft and composition notes: the sense of speed should come from the foreground cliff masses streaking past close to the lens while the distant peaks and clouds drift more slowly, creating strong parallax that reads as a fast, soaring flight through the terrain; the leading edges of the nearest rock should be slightly motion-softened while the midground stays legible. The warm light should be unmistakably golden-hour-through-storm: shafts of light spearing down between cloud banks, catching the tops of ridges and the upper surfaces of the mist so the valley glows from within, while the undersides of clouds and the canyon shadows stay rich and warm-brown. Keep the rock detail painterly but believable, with stratified layers and weathered faces, and let the mist pool realistically in the low folds of the land. The small grey disclaimer caption must remain quietly legible in the lower-left without drawing focus from the spectacle. The overall feeling is awe and momentum — a cinematic establishing flythrough that sells scale and adventure before the vehicle returns to the screen.

Texture and surfaces: clean glossy white automotive paint, matte black cladding and wheels, thick churning dust, and cracked dry desert earth. The truck fills the center of the frame in pure lateral profile, its body angled into the slide, the front wheels turned and the rear wheels spinning to fling a wide dense arc of warm amber dust, grit and small pebbles up and back off the rear tires. Over the bed sits a black tubular sport bar fitted with a flat cargo basket, the truck rides on chunky all-terrain tires, and a slim vertical red LED tail light glows at the rear corner; the glossy white bodywork wears a faint film of dust. Behind the truck, soft glowing backlit desert mountains rise through warm dust haze, lit by a low sun directly behind the vehicle. Superimposed in the lower-right corner is a Korean caption flanked by thin vertical bars reading exactly '|파워풀한 디젤 & 가솔린|', with '파워풀한' in regular weight and '디젤 & 가솔린' in bold, in clean white. Lighting is a low warm backlight at roughly 3600K coming from behind the vehicle, scattering through the dust into a glowing haze, with medium fill, a bright rim outlining the truck's roofline and sport bar, soft dust-diffused shadows and a medium-high contrast. Lens rendering: a normal cinematic lens around 50mm full-frame equivalent, the truck crisp while the dust arc and mountains soften, with a backlit lens flare and subtle grain. Composition centers the drifting truck with the dust arc sweeping out behind it, the low camera emphasizing power and planting. Color palette and strategy: a rich golden backlit grade — warm dust midtone (#C28B54), backlit golden haze (#E6C290), shadowed dust and mountains (#9A7250), bright neutral white vehicle body (#EDEAE5) and dark undercarriage and wheels (#5C4631); the neutral white truck and its red tail light pop against the warm haze. Texture and surfaces: glossy white automotive paint dusted with fine grit, matte black sport bar and wheels, flying pebbles and grit, and soft glowing mountains behind. Atmosphere: explosive energy and heroic action bathed in golden warmth. Post and signature look: photoreal automotive action with a warm cinematic grade, dense volumetric dust, backlit flare and film grain; CG vehicle on a generative-AI-assisted desert plate. Style anchor: high-end automotive CG commercial, Korean. Preserve the on-screen Korean caption '|파워풀한 디젤 & 가솔린|' exactly; render any badge generically; no real logos, no people, no celebrity likeness. Additional craft and composition notes: the drift should be captured at the most dynamic instant of the slide, with the chassis loaded onto its outer suspension and the body subtly leaning, the front wheels visibly steered into the turn and the rear axle breaking traction; the dust arc should not be a uniform cloud but a layered, turbulent curtain — denser and warmer where it leaves the spinning tire, thinning into luminous backlit haze as it rises, with a few sharp pebbles and clods frozen mid-flight at the leading edge. The low camera height should put the horizon near the truck's beltline so the vehicle feels powerful and grounded, and a thin bright rim should separate the roofline, sport bar and cargo basket from the glowing background. The pale paint should pick up warm bounce on its shadow side and a cool sky tint on top, with a faint film of clinging dust dulling the lower panels.
